subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 06, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 06, 2026**

**OpenSSH 10.6 Released**

The OpenSSH team has announced the release of version 10.6, which includes several security updates and improvements. This release addresses a large number of vulnerabilities and issues, making it an important update for all users. As a community-driven Linux distribution, AcreetionOS will be incorporating this update into our next release to ensure the security and stability of our users' systems.

**Community News**

* The AcreetionOS community has been actively contributing to the project, with several community members working on various tasks and issues. We appreciate the dedication and enthusiasm of our community members, and we're excited to see the project grow and evolve.
* The AcreetionOS Discord server has been bustling with activity, with discussions on various topics ranging from development to user support. We encourage all community members to join the server and participate in the conversation.

**Practical Tip**

* Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS system to the latest version of OpenSSH by running the following command in the terminal: `sudo pacman -Syyu && sudo pacman -S openssh`? This will update your system and install the latest version of OpenSSH.
